scenes.title: AND
scenes.narration: AND combines conditions so a row must satisfy every one of them to be kept.

scenes.title: How AND works
bullets: Requires all conditions to be true
Narrows results as you add more
scenes.narration: AND joins conditions such that a row qualifies only when all of them are true. Each additional condition narrows the result further, tightening your filter. It is most often used inside WHERE to express compound requirements.

scenes.title: Two conditions with AND
scenes.narration: This query keeps a product only if both conditions hold at once. The price must exceed fifty and the category must equal Books. Any product failing either test is excluded from the result.

scenes.title: Evaluating an AND chain
scenes.narration: The engine evaluates the conditions in the AND chain one after another. As soon as any condition is false, the row is rejected. Only rows where every condition is true make it into the result.

scenes.text: AND tightens your filter by demanding that all conditions hold together.
scenes.narration: Use AND when a row must meet several requirements at once, and remember each condition you add makes the result more selective.
